2048 Game

The real 2048 puzzle — slide tiles with arrows or swipe, merge matching numbers, and chase the 2048 tile. Score and best saved.

0

Best

Use arrow keys / WASD or swipe.

📖 How to use

  1. Press New game.
  2. Slide tiles with arrow keys or swipe.
  3. Matching tiles merge into their sum.
  4. Reach 2048 to win — then keep going!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I play?

Arrow keys (or WASD) on desktop, swipe on mobile. Every move slides all tiles and merges matching pairs.

How do I win?

You win when you create the 2048 tile — but you can keep playing for a higher score after that.

Is my best score saved?

Your best score is saved in this browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — touch swipe is fully supported.
